item.title: About
item.dc:creator: rsainju982
item.content:encoded:
Making student wellbeing easier, more accessible and more affordable.

Welcome to Herts Wellbeing, your local guide to health, fitness and positive living across Hertfordshire.

Our aim is to encourage individuals, families and communities to lead healthier, happier and more active lives by making local wellbeing opportunities easier to discover.

We believe that wellbeing is about more than just physical fitness. It includes maintaining a healthy lifestyle, looking after mental wellbeing, staying active, enjoying the outdoors and building positive connections within the community.

Through Herts Wellbeing, we aim to bring together useful information about local gyms, sports facilities, parks, walking trails, community activities and wellbeing events, helping people discover opportunities to improve their everyday lives.

Our aim is to encourage students of all fitness levels to explore what's available around Hatfield, try something new and make physical activity part of everyday student life.

item.title: Parks & Walking Trails in Hatfield
item.dc:creator: rsainju982
item.content:encoded:
Explore Parks in Hertfordshire

Discover some of Hertfordshire's most beautiful parks and green spaces. Whether you enjoy peaceful walks, outdoor exercise, cycling, picnics or exploring nature, there's something for everyone.

From scenic lakes and woodland trails to spacious parks and gardens, find the perfect place to get outdoors, stay active and enjoy the fresh air.

1. Ellenbrook Fields

  • Location: Behind de Havilland campus, Hatfield
  • Cost: Free
  • Best For: Outdoor walking, running, and quiet study breaks
  • Transport: 10-minute walk from de Havilland campus
  • Date Checked: October 2026

2. Stanborough Park

  • Location: Welwyn Garden City
  • Cost: Free park entry
  • Best For: Lakeside walks and weekend relaxation
  • Transport: Short ride on the Uno Bus from campus
  • Date Checked: October 2026

3. Hatfield Park

  • Walking trails: Three signposted routes of approximately 1.4, 2.1 and 3.1 miles.
  • Dogs: Allowed in the park.
  • Cycling: Bikes and scooters are not permitted inside the park.
  • Parking: Free visitor parking.
  • Opening: Seasonal opening times apply; check before visiting.

item.title: Parks
item.dc:creator: ug25aae
item.content:encoded:
Explore Parks in Hertfordshire

Discover some of Hertfordshire’s most beautiful parks and green spaces. Whether you enjoy peaceful walks, outdoor exercise, cycling, picnics or exploring nature, there’s something for everyone.

From scenic lakes and woodland trails to spacious parks and gardens, find the perfect place to get outdoors, stay active and enjoy the fresh air.

1. Ellenbrook Fields

  • Location: Behind de Havilland campus, Hatfield
  • Cost: Free
  • Best For: Outdoor walking, running, and quiet study breaks
  • Transport: 10-minute walk from de Havilland campus
  • Date Checked: October 2026

2. Stanborough Park

  • Location: Welwyn Garden City
  • Cost: Free park entry
  • Best For: Lakeside walks and weekend relaxation
  • Transport: Short ride on the Uno Bus from campus
  • Date Checked: October 2026

3. Hatfield Park

  • Walking trails: Three signposted routes of approximately 1.4, 2.1 and 3.1 miles.
  • Dogs: Allowed in the park.
  • Cycling: Bikes and scooters are not permitted inside the park.
  • Parking: Free visitor parking.
  • Opening: Seasonal opening times apply; check before visiting.

4. Cassiobury Park – Watford

  • Walking Trails: Numerous walking paths through parkland, woodland and along the Grand Union Canal.
  • Dogs: Allowed.
  • Cycling: Cycling is possible on suitable permitted routes.
  • Parking: Car parks available; charges and restrictions vary.
  • Opening: Open throughout the year.

5. Verulamium Park – St Albans

  • Walking Trails: Lakeside paths and routes through historic parkland.
  • Dogs: Allowed; keep under control.
  • Cycling: Use permitted shared paths and routes.
  • Parking: Nearby car parks; charges may apply.
  • Opening: Generally open throughout the year.

6. Fairlands Valley Park – Stevenage

  • Walking Trails: Lakeside walking paths and routes around the park.
  • Dogs: Allowed; keep under control.
  • Cycling: Cycling is available on suitable park paths.
  • Parking: On-site parking; charges may apply.
  • Opening: Open throughout the year; activity facilities have separate hours.

item.title: Gym in Lutton
item.dc:creator: rsainju982
item.content:encoded:
1. PureGym Luton Retail Park
Location: Luton Retail Park, Luton
Membership: Core £22.99 a month and Plus £29.99 a month. The join page currently shows a discount to £18.99 (Core) and £25.99 (Plus). When it opened, the joining fee was £15.
Opening hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
Facilities: 160+ pieces of kit, including cardio, functional equipment, and free and fixed weights. There’s also free parking, 50kg dumbbells, free Wi-Fi and classes included. It’s no contract.

2. PureGym Luton and Dunstable
Location: Skimpot Lane, Luton, LU4 0JB
Membership: Core £20.99 a month and Plus £27.99 a month, each with a £15 joining fee. Some PureGym pages show older lower prices, so check the join page for today’s rate.
Day pass: £6.99 through Hussle
Opening hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
Facilities: Free on-site parking, more than 50 free classes a week, and a dedicated ladies-only area with ladies-only classes. Equipment covers cardio machines, free weights, resistance machines, a Powerplate and a mat area, plus changing rooms, showers and lockers.

3. The Gym Group Luton
Location: C1–C2 The Galaxy, Bridge Street, Luton, LU1 2NB (town centre)
Membership: Off-peak £20.99, Standard £24.99 and Ultimate £30.99 a month (£24.99 for the first month), each plus a £15 joining fee. There’s also a 12-month saver option at £339 upfront with no joining fee.
Opening hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
Facilities: Free classes, personal trainers, cardio machines and free weights. Ultimate adds multi-gym access, one free membership freeze, guest passes and free Fiit online workouts. One member review mentions paying for parking nearby, so check parking before joining.

4. Active Luton – Inspire: Luton Sports Village / Lewsey Sports Park
Location: Inspire: Luton Sports Village, Butterfield Green Road, LU2 8DD, or Lewsey Sports Park & Pool, Pastures Way, LU4 0PF
Membership:

  • Inspire multi-centre (Adult): £44.99 a month
  • Lewsey dual-centre (Adult): £30.99 a month
  • Student/Senior rates: £36 (Inspire) and £24.75 (Lewsey)
    Pay as you go: Adult gym sessions £10, after a required induction.
    Opening hours: Not 24/7. Check each centre’s timetable.
    Facilities: Over 200 classes a week across the centres with multi-centre membership. The multi-centre plan also lets you use Lewsey, Lea Manor, High Town Gym and Stockwood Athletics Centre, and there are women-only gym sessions. Lewsey has a 70-station gym with plenty of free parking.

item.title: Gym in St Albans
item.dc:creator: rsainju982
item.content:encoded:
1. PureGym St Albans
Location: Unit 3, Abbey View Retail Park, AL1 2RJ
Membership: Off-Peak £23.99, Core £30.99, or Plus £37.99 a month, plus a £15 joining fee
Opening hours: 24/7
Facilities: Gym over two floors, cardio and resistance machines, free weights, 50+ classes included, and free parking.

2. Everyone Active – Westminster Lodge Leisure Centre
Location: Holywell Hill, AL1 2DL, near Verulamium Park
Membership: Bundles from £26.99 a month, depending on what’s included. Day pass for £7.40 through Hussle.
Opening hours: Not 24/7. Check the centre's timetable.
Facilities: 200-station gym, swimming pool, sauna, steam room, fitness studios, climbing walls, hot yoga studio, and the Verulamium Spa.

3. Fitness First St. Albans
Location: Christopher Place Shopping Centre, St Albans City Centre
Membership: From £75 a month
Opening hours: Mon–Thu 5:30am–9:30pm, Fri 5:30am–8:30pm, Sat–Sun 7:30am–7:30pm
Facilities: Reformer Pilates, HYROX training area, recovery area, sauna, steam room, cold plunge, and free on-site parking.

item.title: Gym in Borehamwood
item.dc:creator: rsainju982
item.content:encoded:
1. PureGym Borehamwood
Location: The Point, 84 Shenley Road, WD6 1EH
Membership: Core £27.99 a month and Plus £34.99 a month, plus a £15 joining fee
Day pass: £6.99 through Hussle
Opening hours: Mon–Fri 6:30am–11pm, Sat–Sun 8am–10pm. It’s not 24/7.
Facilities: 160+ pieces of kit, brand-new equipment, Les Mills classes like Bodypump and Bodycombat. The nearest parking is Furzehill Road car park.

2. Anytime Fitness Borehamwood
Location: Unit 1CA, Borehamwood Shopping Park, WD6 4PR
Membership: Price not listed online, so enquire with the gym. Day pass £8.60 through Hussle.
Opening hours: 24/7. It’s the only 24/7 gym in town.
Facilities: 3 hours’ free parking, a 2-minute walk from Elstree & Borehamwood station, access to Anytime clubs worldwide, personal and small group training.

3. The Venue (InspireAll)
Location: 12 Elstree Way, Borehamwood
Membership: Monthly price not listed online, so check with InspireAll. Day pass £10, or Hussle Monthly+ £52.50.
Opening hours: Not 24/7. Check the centre’s timetable.
Facilities: Fitness studio with cardio and resistance kit, free weights area, swimming pool, sauna, steam room and personal training.
